cases.name: LeAnna Mae Pitts
cases.about:
She was director of work management and administrative support within the University of Oregon's Campus Planning and Facilities Management team. LeAnna Pitts had a personal tie to the faith-based Teen Challenge, which at the time was under the umbrella of a national organization led by her father, Mike Hodges. The organization is now known as Adult & Teen Challenge, and has a regional operation based in Milwaukie run by Chris Hodges, brother of LeAnna Pitts.

At the University of Oregon, facilities and planning staffers described LeAnna Pitts as “much loved, admired, and respected,” Seydel said in an email.

“She was an amazing person, supervisor, and coworker. This is a huge loss and those who loved her are heartbroken,” Seydel said.
